newsitem.title: UK: European jet gains with gas oil, premiums steady.
newsitem.headline: European jet gains with gas oil, premiums steady.

text.p: European jet fuel premiums to gas oil futures were holding steady on Tuesday with outright prices reflecting gains on IPE gas oil futures.
Traders said second half February barges were talked around March IPE gas oil +$27 a tonne cif NWE with cargoes pegged around March IPE +$30..
Traders said there were several cargoes looking for homes, but that the high February gas oil screen, which was showing backwardation of up to $10 a tonne for much of Tuesday, was putting buyers off.
"Hopefully when the Feb contract expires tomorrow, we will get some liquidity," said one trader.
